1
Zameen Se Arsh Pe Taray Ochalne Wale Rehan Azmi.
Bhanwar Se Nooh Ki Kashti Nikalne Walay.
Ahad Hai Wajid-o-Hayi-o-Wahab-o-Wajid Tu.
Tamam Bandishein Lamhon Mein Talney Walay.

2
Karam, Kareem Tera Har Taraf Karan Ta Karaan.
Aye Aab-e-Nisaan Ko Gohar Mein Dhalne Walay.
Majeed-o-Majid-o-Mabood Our Mueed Hai Tu.
Hamara Paikar-e-Khaki Sanwarne Walay.

3
Qadeer Qadir-o-Ghaffar-o-Awwal-o-Aakhir.
Nizam-e-Shams-o-Qamar Ko Sanbhalne Walay.
Mila Ke Aab Mein Khak-o-Hawa-o-Aatish Ko.
Phir Oss Khameer Ko Banda Pokarne Walay.

4
Zameen Pe Sabzay Ki Chadar Bichayi Kun Keh Kar.
Aye Farsh-e-Khak Ki Qismat Nikharne Walay.
Shikam Mein Sang Ke Deta Hai Rizq Keray Ko.
Hijar Shajar Ko Parindon Ko Palney Walay.

5
Banaya Ashraf e Makhlooq Tu Ne Aadam Ko.
Farishtay Ho Gaye Sajdah Guzarne Walay.
 Rehan Haar Gaye Oss Ke Samne Woh Bhi.
Woh Loag Jo They Kissi Se Na Harne Walay.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zameen-se-arsh-pe-taray-ochalne-wale-rehan-azmi-tajpoints-be89477ebf8d423ec53a.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---\\n')
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for text, digits in [(roman, '12345'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵')]:
    stanzas = text.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(stanzas) == 5
    for stanza, digit in zip(stanzas, digits):
        lines = stanza.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == digit and len(lines) == 5
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines() if line)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 20 verses in Urdu script and verified that the five stanzas match the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the title and right-to-left metadata and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Only the selected lyric was edited.

I kept “Rehan Azmi” in the opening verse as transcribed, rendered both occurrences of “Wajid” as واجد, and read “Hijar” as حجر.
